strategies.name: Real-Scale Preview
strategies.rationale: Place the subject at true scale in the room.

strategies.name: Tabletop Miniature
strategies.rationale: Shrink a large subject onto the table so it's graspable.

strategies.name: Exploded View
strategies.rationale: Separate parts along assembly axes to reveal structure.

strategies.name: Cutaway View
strategies.rationale: Slice the shell away to expose interior anatomy in situ.

strategies.name: X-Ray View
strategies.rationale: Make the shell transparent to see internals without removing them.

strategies.name: Assembly Sequence
strategies.rationale: Build the subject up step by step in space.

strategies.name: Disassembly Sequence
strategies.rationale: Take the subject apart step by step (reverse assembly).

strategies.name: Animated Process
strategies.rationale: Show the process in motion as a seamless loop.

strategies.name: Timeline Story
strategies.rationale: Lay events along a spatial line the user walks.

strategies.name: Side-by-Side Comparison
strategies.rationale: Place options on an equal-distance arc to choose between them.

strategies.name: Layered Breakdown
strategies.rationale: Peel the subject into stacked semantic layers.

strategies.name: Flow Visualization
strategies.rationale: Visualise movement/quantity flowing through a system.

strategies.name: Cause & Effect
strategies.rationale: Stage a trigger and its consequence so the link is seen.

strategies.name: Guided Tour
strategies.rationale: Walk the user through staged beats with attention cues.

strategies.name: Interactive Sandbox
strategies.rationale: Give direct controls to manipulate the subject.

strategies.name: Scale Compression
strategies.rationale: Compress an enormous subject (solar system) to comprehensible size.

strategies.name: Scale Expansion
strategies.rationale: Expand a tiny subject (a cell, an atom) to room scale.

strategies.name: Before / After
strategies.rationale: Show two states of the same subject side by side.

strategies.name: System Map
strategies.rationale: Lay a system out as nodes and links you can trace.

strategies.name: Part-to-Whole
strategies.rationale: Move between a part and the whole it belongs to.
